text:
Alex G (Growth): Quick idea — run a 20-min lightning webinar + live demo next Wed to push a new starter-credit experiment. low-friction, short CTA, and a benchmark story we can publish. :rocket:
Maya P (Content): love it. do we have a headline? thinking: 'Ship smarter with Redwood — free credits + prompt templates' short & punchy.
TJ (Analytics): metrics to validate? retention at 7 days + token usage first 48h. propose primary metric: pct of attendees who run >=3 requests within 24h.
Zara (PM): cohort question — target new signups only or include churned free users? my vote: new signups + 7-day trial starters. keeps signal clean.
Alex G (Growth): agree with Zara. new signups + trial starters. low noise. Maya can we draft slide copy + 2 email variants for invite and follow-up?
Maya P (Content): yes. I'll do invite + follow-up. Variant A: demo-first CTA (join demo + claim credits). Variant B: guide-first CTA (get starter prompt pack + credits).
TJ (Analytics): here's the routing plan snippet I suggest, can ops implement?:
```
route: webinar_plg_lightning
cohorts: [new_signups_72h, trial_starters_7d]
variant_A: credits_on_register
variant_B: credits_on_post_demo
metrics: [attend_rate, 24h_active_pct, 7d_retention_pct]
```
Zara (PM): can we also gate prompt templates by use-case? e.g., sales outreach vs ideation. that will help benchmark output quality.
Alex G (Growth): good call. include 2 prompt packs: "Outreach" and "Idea Spark". small survey in follow-up to tag use-case.
TJ (Analytics): target numbers: attend_rate 20%+, 24h_active_pct 12%+, 7d_retention 6%+. we'll run A/B for credits timing. link to tracking doc: http://go/reports/webinar-lightning (internal).
Maya P (Content): copy snippets ready by EOD today. short subject lines, quick bullets, and 1-liner demo transcript.
OpsBot: calendar event created for 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC. Guest link is private. Invite sent to panel: Alex, Maya, Zara, TJ.
Alex G (Growth): awesome. TJ, can you set up the experiment in the dashboard and share toggles? Maya, I'll do social copy + launch post with the benchmark narrative after the webinar.
TJ (Analytics): will do. toggles + dashboard by tomorrow morning. I'll also add a tiny survey to capture feature intent.
Maya P (Content): posted draft invite in #marketing-drafts for review. ping me if you want edits. :white_check_mark:
Alex G (Growth): perfect. next sync tomorrow 11am PT. thanks all. :raised_hands:
